intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
chorus: Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!
verses: Rory has big teeth for a roar,
Brush them, brush them, brush some more!
Top teeth, bottom teeth, one, two, three,
Tiny teeth as white as can be!
Swish and spit and rinse it out,
Ziggy smiles and gives a shout!
Bubbles on his nose, what a sight!
Brush the front and brush the back,
Pebble's beak needs a little scrub,
Up and down and all around,
bridge: Brush the top! Brush, brush, brush!
Brush the bottom! Brush, brush, brush!
Now swish, swish, swish, and spit it out,
Show your smile and give a shout!
